primary_object_card.object_statement: The primary object is a finite, preregistered nonofficial stress campaign that executes the current 139-tool and 29-edge roster, representative old simulations, and bounded later-rung scratch probes under exact runtimes, code gates, and red-preserving receipts without promoting release or science.

source_anchors.quote_or_summary: The finite current roster contains 139 explicitly bucketed tool rows and fixes their operational obligations and claim ceiling.
The finite edge registry contains 29 declared same-runtime and cross-runtime integration witnesses.
Exploration is broad, while admission, promotion, result reconciliation, and shared-state mutation remain conservative and serial.

primary_object_card.plain_language_definition: This campaign is a bounded execution audit, not a new theory result. It freezes a repository base, exact runtime identities, a finite tool and integration-edge roster, selected historical simulation consumers, selected later-rung scratch probes, deterministic gates, negative controls, and receipt paths. Every green and red outcome remains attached to its command and source hashes. No campaign result can authorize release, formal admission, or a scientific rung.

native_terms.nonofficial run: An executable scratch run whose outputs cannot authorize release, admission, or science promotion.
native_terms.old-sim regression corpus: A finite preregistered set of historical simulation consumers replayed only for behavioral regression evidence.
native_terms.later-rung scratch probe: A bounded preview of later work executed with all promotion and official-launch flags disabled.
native_terms.code gate: A deterministic executable predicate over artifacts and receipts that never delegates its verdict to an LLM.
native_terms.red preservation: The rule that informative failures remain immutable evidence and are never weakened into passing thresholds.

weirdness_signature: A broad run may be operationally green while every release and scientific promotion flag remains false.
An expected package absence can be a green policy result while still not being an operational tool pass.
Historical simulation success is regression evidence only and does not inherit current V8 authority or canonical status.
Later-rung execution is useful precisely because deliberate red controls and demotions remain visible.
primary_object_card.domain: The frozen Codex-Ratchet base, canonical Python and declared Julia projects, the finite tool and edge registries, selected old simulations, selected later-rung scratch probes, and deterministic Lev or repository validators.
primary_object_card.codomain_or_output: A machine-readable nonofficial campaign matrix with per-command status, hashes, controls, gate verdicts, red outcomes, omissions, pollution audit, and explicit blocked consumers.
allowed_operations: run read-only environment and pollution preflights
execute the repo-held deep-stack controller with no-install enforced
replay preregistered old simulations as regression consumers
execute bounded later-rung scratch probes with promotion disabled
mutate fixtures or receipts only in copied or isolated campaign surfaces
validate raw and normalized receipts with deterministic code gates
classify outcomes without changing thresholds after observation
required_invariants: the roster and edge registry hashes remain fixed for the campaign
all package-dependent commands record their exact runtime or Julia project
no command installs upgrades or downgrades packages
old-sim outcomes remain regression evidence rather than inherited canon
later-rung outcomes remain scratch and nonofficial
all release formal-admission and scientific-promotion flags remain false
every gate verdict is computed by code rather than an LLM
every informative red outcome remains preserved in the final matrix
forbidden_substitutions: historical-green label for current V8 evidence
LLM-gate analogy for deterministic code validation
later-rung science label for a scratch probe
engine agreement proxy for independent computation
Lev process green label for mathematical or scientific truth
negative_controls: remove or bypass one load-bearing tool call and require demotion
tamper one source or result hash and require validation failure
replay a receipt under a changed run identity and require provenance rejection
erase an integration edge and require its declared co-health or handoff gate to fail
attempt a release or science flag and require fail-closed rejection
primary_object_card.adapter_policy: Runners, old sims, later-rung probes, and Lev evaluators are typed adapters or probes. Each must state what it preserves, what it loses, its exact runtime and command, and its kill control. None becomes the campaign object or a scientific authority.
promotion_locks: no release eligibility from this campaign
no formal admission from this campaign
no scientific rung promotion from this campaign
no roster membership change from this campaign
no threshold repair after observing a red result

lateral_mappings.label: repo-held deep-stack controller
lateral_mappings.target: execute the frozen finite tool and edge roster
preconditions: runtime doctor passes the harness boundary
roster and edge hashes are recorded
lateral_mappings.kill_control: tamper a bound source or result hash and require the receipt validator to reject the estate

lateral_mappings.label: old-sim regression replay
lateral_mappings.target: measure whether representative historical consumers still execute under current runtimes
preserves: current observable pass or red behavior
loses: any claim that the old sim defines V8
preconditions: the corpus is frozen before execution
results are written only in the isolated campaign worktree or scratch directory
lateral_mappings.kill_control: change a fixture or bypass its decisive tool and require the regression row to demote or fail

lateral_mappings.label: later-rung readout
lateral_mappings.target: preview feasibility and failure modes of bounded later-rung work
preconditions: promotion and release flags are false
the probe is root-compatible and bounded
lateral_mappings.kill_control: remove the declared later-rung structure and require its observable or gate to collapse

lateral_mappings.label: Leviathan as laboratory foreman
lateral_mappings.target: coordinate deterministic gates and receipt routing without deciding scientific truth
preconditions: Lev calls code validators rather than LLM verdicts
all process receipts stay below the scientific claim ceiling
lateral_mappings.kill_control: replace the deterministic verifier with an LLM judgment and require the Lev gate to be classified invalid

fixation_breakers: preserve at least one red or demoted lane rather than optimizing only for green totals
if one engine family dominates the corpus add an independent family or mark the imbalance
if a later-rung readout survives only through shared code classify it as hollow parity

loop_contract.stop_condition: stop when the frozen finite corpus has terminal receipts, a harness boundary fails, or the next action would require an install, threshold change, owner-worktree mutation, or promotion beyond the declared ceiling
loop_contract.repair_rule: repair only the first harness or receipt-boundary defect; never repair a scientific red by changing the preregistered gate

method_contracts.question_is_not_authorization: A question asks for an answer; it is not authorization to implement unless the user explicitly says to do it.
method_contracts.order_check_separate: Any sequence or ordering claim must be checked separately from content correctness, with the order witness named.
method_contracts.baseline_preservation: When debugging runtime behavior, preserve the tuned visible or output baseline and debug the execution path underneath.
method_contracts.falsifier_first: A Popper pass names the target claim, strongest live falsifier, decisive check, and killed, open, or survived classification before agreement.
method_contracts.feynman_testability: A Feynman pass names the operation, the observable measured, and the pass/fail condition.
method_contracts.synthesis_refusal: Synthesis must name distinct receipts and explicitly refuse the merge, sequence, or reframe it is not performing.
method_contracts.human_offload: Resolve with tools before asking; ask the human only for private, preference-bound, or unrecoverable information.
